result:
This confirms the four services are wired up at process start via `registerEventHandlers()`, and notification-service (imported transitively) does not subscribe to `issue.created` — only `issue.assigned`, `issue.overdue`, `comment.created`, and `member.joined`.

The four files that register handlers reacting to `issue.created`:
- `src/server/services/activity-service.ts` — records an activity log entry
- `src/server/services/search-service.ts` — indexes the new issue for search
- `src/server/services/usage-service.ts` — increments org usage counters
- `src/server/services/webhook-service.ts` — enqueues outbound webhook deliveries

`src/server/services/issue-service.ts` publishes the event rather than handling it, and `src/types/event.ts`, `src/types/activity.ts`, `src/schemas/activity.ts`, `src/schemas/webhook.ts`, and `src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts` only declare/label the event name.

ANSWER: src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/usage-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts
